required_artifacts: 12 unique surface PNGs rendered from the same final-template PDF
print-scale reviewer attestation and editorial/safety dispositions
final_review_checks: title/subtitle final owner lock exact and legible
body font not shrunk to force fit
correct Polish diacritics and no clipped glyphs
no omitted or orphaned START / W DWIE OSOBY / NA JUTRO
no split or truncated consent/no-touch alternatives
happy makers comments visually subordinate to instructions
no loss of narrative hierarchy or overlaps in crowded pages
PDF and screenshots are from actual current template, not a proxy
evidence_acceptance: Validator checks exact source/hash/artifact and reviewer declarations; independent editorial/safety examination of real pages is mandatory and never inferable from CI alone.
denied: historical R5 proof as R6 proof
synthetic/demo/test renderer as final production evidence
